system.description:
At 2nd level, you and your companion begin to work more closely with one another in combat. Your companion gains a second hit die at level two. They gain an additional hit die, and an additional ability, at 4th, 7th, 10th, 13th, 16th, 19th, and 20th levels as shown on the table. At 20th level, your companion gains 4 additional hit dice for a total of 12.

In addition, you may teach your companion one combat maneuver that you know at each of these levels, though they must use exertion from your pool to activate the maneuver.
